blends.name: Blend for Midnight Helmet
blends.desc:
Blend all 3 Legendary virtues from Solar set to receive a **Midnight Helmet**, which is an essential item and neccessary in completing your very own **Midnight Suit**.

**ALL WAX ADDRESSES THAT PARTICIPATE IN THIS BLEND WILL ALSO RECEIVE SINGULARITY EDITIONS OF ALL 3 VIRTUES, AIRDROPPED WITHIN 24 HOURS OF BLENDING.**

Legendary virtues can be found here on Atomichub: https://wax.atomichub.io/market?collection_name=travelercard
Join our Discord: dsc.gg/travelerscards
